# GENERATED by tools/exact/generate.py from rules.ini — do not edit

Every place the Exact twins (actors.yaml, reimagined.yaml, weapons/exact/weapons.yaml) differ from a field-by-field conversion of the base RA2 rules.ini. Each section is an entry of `tools/exact/exceptions.py`; those with a rule adjust the generated values, the others are made by the generator itself. Units and constants: `tools/exact/conversions.py` and `tools/exact/TIMING.md`.

## tesla-charge

- Field: AttackTesla ReloadDelay (and MaxCharges) of twins with AttackTesla (atesla.exact, tesla.exact); ReloadDelay of their weapons (PrismShot.exact, CoilBolt.exact, OPCoilBolt.exact)
- Applied by: rule `tesla_charge`
- Reason: The mod splits RA2's ROF into a charge-up (AttackTesla InitialChargeDelay) and a reload (AttackTesla ReloadDelay, with a short weapon ReloadDelay), and the Tesla Coil fires volleys of three bolts. Exact keeps charge + reload equal to RA2's ROF and fires one bolt per ROF, as RA2 does. The Tesla Coil's overpowered OPCoilBolt (RA2 ROF 100) and normal CoilBolt (ROF 120) share one AttackTesla: the trait is timed for the faster weapon and the slower one's own ReloadDelay holds it to its ROF. RA2 values are used for everything else (damage, range, Versus).
- Affected:
  - atesla.exact: AttackTesla ReloadDelay 28; charge 22 + reload 28 = 50 ticks
  - PrismShot.exact: ReloadDelay 28 (RA2 ROF 50 ticks - charge 22)
  - tesla.exact: AttackTesla ReloadDelay 61, MaxCharges 1; charge 22 + reload 61 = 83 ticks
  - CoilBolt.exact: ReloadDelay 100 (RA2 ROF; the armament sets the pace)
  - OPCoilBolt.exact: ReloadDelay 61 (RA2 ROF 83 ticks - charge 22)

## mind-control

- Field: MindControl.exact, SuperMindControl.exact: ReloadDelay, Range, Burst only
- Applied by: rule `mind_control`
- Reason: RA2's Damage=10 sits on the Controller warhead, which takes control of the target instead of damaging it; the mod's MindController trait does that and the weapon's TargetDamage stays at 0. Exact takes RA2's ROF and Range and keeps 0 damage.
- Affected:
  - MindControl.exact: ReloadDelay, Range, Burst from RA2 MindControl; RA2 Damage=10 not applied
  - SuperMindControl.exact: ReloadDelay, Range, Burst from RA2 SuperMindControl; RA2 Damage=10 not applied

## demo-truck-targeting

- Field: DemoTruckTargeting.exact (Terrorist, Demolition Truck)
- Applied by: rule `stub`
- Reason: RA2's Terrorist and Demolition Truck fire TerrorBomb/Demobomb, suicide weapons whose damage is the explosion. The mod's actors fire DemoTruckTargeting, a no-damage targeting weapon that triggers KillsSelf, and the explosion is their FireWarheadsOnDeath weapon (TerrorBomb, demobomb). The targeting twin stays a stub; the explosions are twinned as RA2 death weapons (see death-weapons).
- Affected:
  - DemoTruckTargeting.exact: Inherits stub

## veterancy

- Field: GainsExperience Conditions and the rank multipliers of twins with GainsExperience (globals.yaml)
- Applied by: the generator
- Reason: RA2 promotes at VeteranRatio x the unit's cost of kills (x2 for elite) and grants each rank's abilities as flags: an elite unit has its VeteranAbilities plus its EliteAbilities, and an ability in both applies once. The mod's ^GainsExperience grows every bonus at each rank. Exact sets the thresholds to VeteranRatio x100 and x200 % of the value, each @VETERAN/@ELITE multiplier to VeteranCombat (FIREPOWER), 1 / VeteranArmor (STRONGER), VeteranROF (ROF) or VeteranSpeed (FASTER) when the rank has that ability and 100 otherwise, InaccuracyMultiplier@ELITE to 100 (RA2 has no accuracy bonus), and keeps the self-heal (ChangesHealth@ELITE, at the mod's rate: RA2 states none) only with SELF_HEAL, from the first rank that has it.
- Affected:
  - dog.exact: no GainsExperience trait, RA2 abilities not applied
  - 47 twins with GainsExperience

## survivors

- Field: SpawnSurvivors of twins (destroyed buildings)
- Applied by: the generator
- Reason: RA2: a Crewed=yes building releases its sell value (Cost x RefundPercent) divided by AlliedSurvivorDivisor or SovietSurvivorDivisor crew (AlliedCrew/SovietCrew), rounded down. The mod's lists are fixed per building. Exact writes that count of the crew of the side the mod's list uses (its other entries, e.g. the construction yards' engineer, are kept) and removes the trait when nothing is left. Survivors of a sold building (SpawnActorsOnSell) keep the mod's lists.

## crew-escape

- Field: EjectOnDeath on twins of RA2 Crewed=yes vehicles and aircraft
- Applied by: the generator
- Reason: RA2 lets the crew of a destroyed Crewed=yes vehicle escape with CrewEscape chance; the mod has no crew. ## lightning-storm

- Field: Lightning Storm weapon twin and timing
- Applied by: the generator
- Reason: RA2 has no weapon section for the storm: its damage is [General] LightningDamage with the LightningWarhead's Verses, CellSpread and PercentAtMax, written onto the mod's storm weapon. LightningDeferment (delay before the storm starts) and LightningSeparation have no field in WeatherControlSupportPower and are not applied. LightningCellSpread=10 is not written: the power's default OffsetsX/OffsetsY of -5c0..5c0 already spread the clouds over a 10-cell area.
- Affected:

## spy-satellite

- Field: RevealsMap of the Spy Satellite twin (#803): the base trait is kept
- Applied by: the generator
- Reason: RA2 has no fog of war: once the SpySat reveals the map, it stays visible for good (only Gap Generators shroud it again). The mod plays with fog of war, and its RevealsMap (live vision of the whole map while powered, !lowpower) is the closest equivalent, so the twin keeps it. A faithful mechanic, permanent passive visibility that yields to Gap Generators, needs a new trait and is a follow-up.
- Affected:
  - gaspysat.exact: the base RevealsMap is kept (RequiresCondition !lowpower)

## neutral-tech-buildings

- Field: Exact/Reimagined trait pairs of caairp, cahosp, caoild, caoutp, cathosp (globals.yaml)
- Applied by: the generator
- Reason: Tech buildings are not twinned: they are neutral when the map starts and change owner when captured. GrantConditionOnPrerequisite@BALANCE grants balance-exact while the owner has balance.exact, and each balance trait whose RA2 value differs from the mod's becomes a X@EXACT/X@REIMAGINED pair (the Reimagined side is copied from the mod's rule files without globals.yaml). Health (not conditional) keeps the mod's value (RA2's Strength is the same). The Exact paratroopers have their own OrderName (`...Exact`): powers sharing an OrderName share one timer. ## frame-rate

- Field: Every time, speed and turn rate conversion (exact.conversions)
- Applied by: the generator
- Reason: RA2's frame rate is the measured 30 frames per second (speed slider position 4, chosen as the reference for OpenRA's Normal speed; tools/exact/TIMING.md section 4), so one RA2 frame is 0.8333 OpenRA ticks, and a rules.ini minute is the engine's 900 frames = 30 s = 750 ticks. Speed and ROT keep the mod's x15 / x4 factors scaled by the same ratio (an unmeasured hypothesis). rules.ini comments IronCurtainDuration=750 with "In frames 900 is a minute for 15fps"; that is the design basis, not the measured rate.
- Affected:
  - RA2_FRAMES_PER_SECOND = 30 (OPENRA_TICKS_PER_SECOND = 25)
  - MINUTES_ARE_FRAMES = True
